name: sol-12-cli-startup
goal: Keep CLI startup independent of generated app configs and block guide completion only on named unit states

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: 8d405f736e introduced Desktop imports; fresh CLI now fails before argument dispatch. Main alone starts.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Root setup generated app configs before collection. Strengthened the existing config-readiness and units-guide cases without adding cases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 68d25e32a4 sealed three failing cases, including the exact fresh CLI shortCommit alias error.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Read proofs through root history services; narrow selector input to revision fields. Keep named states required and guesses advisory. Enforce unsynced startup in normal config-readiness coverage.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Root proof services replace Desktop imports. Named states alone determine DONE; guesses are separate. All 35 owning and 12 selector cases pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: de053adc0a passes the unchanged 12-case matrix in the same environment as red 68d25e32a4; sealed green b757a219c8dd.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: In an isolated export, restoring the 68d25e32a4 unitShots imports fails the existing config-readiness case (exit 1). Restored repair passes (exit 0); tracked drift is empty.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
